sentences.en: The bad boy does not answer his mother.
Julius does not give the woman little bags.
The ugly gates do not please the enemy.
The man gives his boy a sack.

sentences.la: Servus bonus puerō suō nōn respondet.
sentences.en: The good slave does not answer his boy.
The empty sacks do not please Aemilia.

sentences.la: Ancilla patrī pirum dat, et pater lacrimat.
sentences.en: The slave girl gives the father a pear, and the father weeps.
The porter does not give Delia honey.
The mothers give their enemies sacks.
To whom does Aemilia give her mirror?

sentences.la: Mārcus Cornēliō et servīs saccōs dat.
sentences.en: Marcus gives Cornelius and the slaves sacks.
